description: AnalyzeActivation publishes partial evidence by design (semantic.rs:179) to avoid deadlocking recursive cones; this tears down + re-publishes replacing facts (~4040 None->Some), each read as a change. Preserving omitted replacing publishers is UNSOUND (claims overwritten value). Investigate gating downstream-visible replacing publications on settled inputs WITHOUT deadlocking the recursive cone — e.g. settle-gate only the seal-visible replacing facts, or a two-phase publish. Grounded plan only.

comments.text: SPIKE PLAN (prototyped + measured, 00420). The naive hypothesis (None->Some reappearance churn wakes the seal) is REAL at the fact layer but NOT the binding constraint: two surgical prototypes (settled-wake gate in scheduler.rs:169-176; conditional seal follow_up at semantic.rs:105/212/254) moved gate metrics by ~0. Measured: genuine ascents ~14000 bumps DWARF reappearances ~3293; agenda already coalesces ~2800 wakes -> ~337 seal runs; seal is re-demanded from many sources (DeriveRuntimeDemand, transport.rs:702/849, artifact.rs:54). The UNIQUE lever = ~395 replacing-fact RETRACTIONS (CallSiteSummary 144/Activation 81/ReturnType 80/ActivationAnalyzed 80/Executable 42/RuntimeDemand 48): each is classified shift=true (scheduler.rs:158) -> REBASES all subscribers (scheduler.rs:226) -> rebased conclusion REPLACES cumulative stores instead of joining (scheduler.rs:33-37,160) -> forces re-ascent. Bare reappearances are shift=false (ascent). WHY partial-publish exists: analyze_activation reads cone-peer ReturnType as CURRENT not wait (semantic.rs:1613-1617 'mutual recursion cannot deadlock'); the 'partial' is the reachable-callsite/output set fluctuating as input evidence ascends round-by-round (clause skipped semantic.rs:137; value_ty None guards). FIX = two-tier publication: add JobEffects.provisional_outputs (or per-output Provisional/Committed tier) DECOUPLED from waits. In scheduler.complete(): provisional outputs go through extend_outputs (NO retraction) + force mark_dirty (never read as Settled) WITHOUT entering the waiting state. analyze_activation publishes COMMITTED when all determining inputs settled (output set no longer fluctuates), PROVISIONAL otherwise (store value rewritten fresh each round). SOUND: provisional force-dirty => is_settled false => seal routes to waits never reads => never consumes provisional value => no stale/overwritten-value claim (native.rs:3223 guard + ..._keeps_callable_boundary_surface_authoritative_... stay green). DEADLOCK-SAFE: no new wait added; cone still ascends via Current iteration; only the seal (Settled reader) is held out until cone quiesces = the desired barrier. BLOCKER today: scheduler hard-couples extend-vs-replace to waiting=!waits.is_empty() (scheduler.rs:115/124/133) - needs the new publication mode. Risk: tier-promotion liveness (every provisional must eventually re-publish committed when its inputs settle - driven by existing Current wake path; assert cone-quiescence). HONEST: 14.2 alone will NOT reach seal<=32 (prototypes prove it); needs 14.1. Worth landing a reusable (ignored) churn-measurement test under this ticket.

title: Spike: deadlock-safe settled-gating of downstream-visible replacing-fact publication (kill partial-publication re-appearance churn)
